gloss: the sun sets; it gets dark

definitions.gloss: the sun sets; it gets dark; evening falls
definitions.explanation: Describes the sun going down and daylight fading. A natural, everyday expression for sunset and the onset of evening.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The sun has started setting earlier.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れる⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Come home before it gets dark.
In winter the sun sets early, so it's already dark by four o'clock.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common everyday expression. The subject ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ refers to the sun/daylight. {暮|く}れる means to come to an end or to darken. Often used to talk about seasonal changes in daylight hours.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れる⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (before sunset)
- {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (the sun sets early)
- {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (after dark)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沈|しず}む→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧: the sun sinks/sets — focuses on the physical sun
- ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧: dusk, twilight — the time period itself
